globe.title: From Saint-Malo to Guadeloupe
globe.body: Les P'tites Barques live on two shores: the corsair city and the Caribbean. Click the map to choose your destination.

host.title: Gwenaëlle
body: I'm Gwenaëlle, a Malouine born and bred — “Neither French nor Breton, Malouin am I!”. I know the hidden treasures of the corsair city, and I've long held a deep love for the Caribbean.
I stay available and attentive to your wellbeing throughout your stay: a message, a question, and I'll get back to you.
host.photoAlt: Aerial view of a turquoise channel at low tide

intro.title: Welcome. I’m Gwenaëlle.
body: I was born in Saint-Malo, the old corsair city, and I know its secrets — the lanes sheltered from the wind, the tides that bare the foreshore, the good addresses no guidebook reveals. I have long loved the light of the Caribbean, too.

Les P'tites Barques are a handful of characterful homes, looked after the way you’d welcome a friend: with care, and the simple wish that you feel at home. I stay reachable at any time, attentive to every detail of your stay.
intro.motto: « Ni Français, ni Breton, Malouin suis ! »

apartments.title: Four addresses, one same care.
apartments.subtitle: From the tiny house in Paramé to the new nest above Grande Anse, each home has its own character — and the same promise of attentiveness.

story.title: From Saint-Malo to Guadeloupe.
body: It begins inside the ramparts, between the old walls and the open sea. In Saint-Malo you grow up with salt water at your feet and your head full of corsair tales and far horizons.

Then comes the call of the Caribbean — that softness, that light, that blue. Les P'tites Barques link the two shores: the same hospitality, whether you wake facing the Sillon or above Grande Anse beach.

saintMalo.metaTitle: Staying in Saint-Malo · Old-town and Paramé rentals
saintMalo.metaDescription: Three holiday rentals in Saint-Malo: two flats inside the walled town near Bon-Secours beach and a tiny house in Paramé. Book direct.
saintMalo.title: Staying in Saint-Malo
saintMalo.subtitle: The walled town and Paramé: three homes by the sea.
saintMalo.heroAlt: Aerial view of small boats at their moorings, Saint-Malo
intro: Three homes in Saint-Malo, run by Gwenaëlle, born and bred in the town. Two are inside the walls, in the heart of the corsair city: Les Remparts Mer and Les Remparts Plage, two former haberdasheries renovated in 2025, a two-minute walk from Bon-Secours beach. The third is in Paramé: a 37 m² tiny house with two terraces and two electric bikes, a short walk from Rochebonne beach and the Sillon, five minutes by car from the old town.

Whether you want a holiday rental inside Saint-Malo’s walls, a flat at the foot of the ramparts or a quiet house in Paramé, you book here directly, with no middleman or commission, and 10% off the nightly price. Check-in, parking, beaches: the practical answers are just below, and Gwenaëlle stays reachable throughout your stay.

faq.a: It depends on the home: at Les Remparts Plage, your host hands you the keys in person; in Paramé, check-in is self-service with a secure key box, and luggage drop-off is possible.
Les Remparts Mer has no on-site parking. Les Remparts Plage has paid parking on site. In Paramé, parking is free on site and in the street.

faq.q: Which beaches can I walk to?
faq.a: From the walled town, Bon-Secours beach is a 2-minute walk from both Remparts homes, and the Sillon is also within walking distance. In Paramé, Rochebonne beach and the Sillon are within walking distance.
Two nights, in each of the homes.

faq.q: Can I come with a baby?
faq.a: Yes. Les Remparts Plage has a baby room with a cot, high chair and baby bath. In Paramé, a cot, high chair and baby bath are lent on request. Les Remparts Mer has a folding bed and a high chair.
You book with Gwenaëlle, with no middleman or commission, and get 10% off the nightly price, applied automatically. Each home page has its own booking calendar, with optional extras for your arrival.

guadeloupe.metaTitle: Staying in Deshaies, Guadeloupe · Sea-view studio
guadeloupe.metaDescription: Air-conditioned studio with a sea-view terrace in Deshaies, Basse-Terre: Rifflet and Grande Anse beaches on foot, free parking. Book direct.
guadeloupe.title: Staying in Deshaies, Guadeloupe
guadeloupe.subtitle: A sea-view studio above Grande Anse.
guadeloupe.heroAlt: Covered sea-view terrace beneath the palm trees, Deshaies
intro: In Deshaies, a small fishing village in north-west Basse-Terre, Les P’tites Barques has its fourth home: a 20 m² studio renovated in 2025 in the Rêves d’Or residence, with a 20 m² sea-view terrace, two hammocks and a dining area. Air-conditioned, with a 160 cm bed and free private parking, it sleeps two guests, plus a baby if needed.

Four beaches are within walking distance: Rifflet in 2 minutes, Gadet in 5, Grande Anse and La Perle in 20. The village, its shops and restaurants are close by, the botanical garden is a short drive, and there is a bus stop in front of the residence. On site, Marjorie looks after the concierge service; Gwenaëlle stays reachable throughout your stay. Booking is direct, with no commission, and 10% off the nightly price.

faq.a: Check-in is self-service, with a secure key box. Marjorie, the concierge, is on site, and luggage drop-off is possible.
The studio has free private parking in the residence (space 4). There is a bus stop in front of the residence.

faq.q: Which beaches can I walk to?
faq.a: Rifflet (2 min), Gadet (5 min), Grande Anse and La Perle (20 min). Beach towels, a parasol and snorkelling gear are provided.

faq.q: Can I come with a baby?
faq.a: Yes: a travel cot (sheets provided), high chair, baby bath, changing table and children’s tableware are on site.
You book with Gwenaëlle, with no middleman or commission, and get 10% off the nightly price, applied automatically. The home page has its own booking calendar, with optional extras for your arrival.
